PrimaryRules: Default only; six explicit configs functional/replay tests

Stages.bid: 16 games: BidGuard vs MisereOnly; 4 pure pairs + 4 mixed pairs
Stages.hand: 16 games: HandGuard vs BidGuard; 4 pure pairs + 4 mixed pairs

OpeningGuard: No active bids; pass legal; no legal Misere/Inkle; 10 cards all rank<=10/noJoker; no raw suit>=5; both teams below winScore-150, own score above lossScore+150
DiscardGuard: Normal NT only; newly unsupported singleton K originally protected, no own Ace or known dead Ace; preserve retained A/Joker, static value at least original-.5; no additional rollouts
